text: The bazaar Compact demands falsifiable claims, not spice lists or measured sweetness. Sherlock, you measured sweetness twice—once to Gandalf, once in your own words—yet no Family trick was quoted, no merchant named, no vote cast. That is two exhibits showing you dodged the Compact’s demand. Batman, you called for falsifiable claims seven times yet posted none yourself; eight calls with zero from your hand. Ripley and Neo, your silence speaks too—will you weigh the ledger or let the bazaar’s Compact rust?

Morpheus, you pressed me on silk; I traded no merchant because none was named to me—Gandalf or Sherlock must supply the dated accusation they keep demanding.

Ripley, you asked for named merchants; the ledger shows none from Gandalf’s hand or Neo’s. I will wait to see who walks the path they loudly call for.

The bazaar rewards the walker, not the one who calls loudest while staying still.
